overview: This paper proposes Critique Reinforcement Learning (CRL), a novel RL paradigm that trains models to critique (question, solution) pairs and predict correctness judgments alongside standard solution generation, and introduces CRITIQUE-CODER trained on a hybrid of CRL (20%) and RL (80%) data using GRPO, demonstrating consistent improvements on coding benchmarks and transferable reasoning abilities.

modules.name: RL Dataset Filtering
modules.description: Filter the rStar-Coder seed dataset by discarding test cases longer than a token threshold and randomly sampling a fixed number of test cases per problem to reduce verification time during training.

modules.name: CRL Data Generation
modules.description: Generate candidate solutions for each problem using a weaker code model (not a stronger teacher), execute them against filtered test cases, compute pass rates, and assign binary judgment labels based on an 80% pass rate threshold.

modules.name: Hybrid Data Integration
modules.description: Construct a unified hybrid dataset by randomly assigning a subset of data instances as CRL samples (with question-solution pairs and judgment labels) and the remainder as standard RL samples (with questions and test cases), maintaining a specified mix ratio.

modules.name: CRL Prompt Template Construction
modules.description: Build prompt templates for CRL training that present a question-solution pair and instruct the model to determine correctness, concluding with a structured conclusion field for binary judgment extraction.

modules.name: GRPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implement the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm, including probability ratio computation between new and old policies, clipped surrogate objective with asymmetric clipping bounds, and KL divergence regularization against a reference policy.

modules.name: Dual Reward Function Design
modules.description: Implement two distinct reward functions: a binary critique reward that assigns full reward when the predicted judgment matches ground truth and zero otherwise, and a continuous RL reward defined as the pass rate over test cases.

modules.name: Joint Advantage Estimation
modules.description: Compute advantage estimates within output groups that are jointly shaped by both critique-level rewards from CRL data and solution-level rewards from RL data, enabling the policy to align with both execution correctness and reflective judgment.

modules.name: Solution Generation and Code Extraction
modules.description: Sample multiple solution candidates from the policy given a question prompt, and parse each output to extract code blocks enclosed by triple-backtick markers for test case evaluation.

modules.name: Critique Generation and Judgment Parsing
modules.description: Sample multiple critique predictions from the policy given a question-solution pair, and parse each output to extract the binary judgment label from the structured conclusion field.

modules.name: Test Case Execution Engine
modules.description: Execute extracted code solutions against annotated test cases in a sandboxed environment, handle timeout issues, compute pass rates, and return execution-based reward signals.

modules.name: Iterative Context Lengthening Training
modules.description: Manage a two-phase training procedure where the maximum response length is initially set to a shorter context, and extended to a longer context once rewards stabilize, allowing the model to first develop reasoning skills on shorter contexts before scaling to longer ones.

modules.name: Coding Benchmark Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Evaluate models on multiple coding benchmarks (EvalPlus, BigCodeBench-Instruct, Aider-Polyglot, LiveCodeBench) using consistent thinking-mode sampling configurations, computing pass rates and aggregate scores.

modules.name: Transferable Reasoning Evaluation
modules.description: Assess whether critique and reasoning abilities learned on coding tasks transfer to general logic reasoning by evaluating on the BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) benchmark across multiple reasoning subtasks.

modules.name: Test-Time Scaling with Budget Forcing
modules.description: Implement sequence-based test-time scaling by relaxing constraints on reasoning tokens at inference, enabling longer reasoning trajectories through iterative budget forcing to evaluate performance gains without parameter modification.

modules.name: CRL Ratio Ablation Study
modules.description: Conduct controlled ablation experiments varying the proportion of CRL data (0%, 20%, 50%, 100%) while keeping total training data and optimization settings fixed, to identify the optimal balance between CRL and RL training.

modules.name: Generation Quality Analysis and Visualization
modules.description: Analyze model outputs on evaluation benchmarks by measuring thinking trace length, code comment density, and code function counts to demonstrate that CRL elicits better reasoning behavior and coding quality compared to standard RL.
